enabledHelp: When off, this API charges no balance or points. Prices and billing conditions are retained for re-enabling. Note: it does not affect package counts or the user-group free quota — configure those below under Metering policy. This switch applies to this API only and does not inherit a global setting.
logHelp: When off, this API's billing entries are hidden from the admin Billing Records view; new entries are also hidden from user billing logs and detailed snapshots are not stored. Call logs, essential settlement/refund records and usage statistics are retained.
loadFailed: Could not load billing rules. Close and retry; saving is disabled to protect existing settings.
statsUnavailable: Statistics are temporarily unavailable. Refresh later; previous data is retained.
meteringHelp: Splits charging into three independent dimensions: balance/points, package counts and the user-group free quota. Inherit keeps today's rules — the billing switch and price decide charging, an available package is consumed first, and the free quota counts per user-group limits.
assetHelp: Never charge keeps the configured price but never bills it. Always charge bills whenever the API has a price and skips the billing conditions.
packageHelp: Do not consume keeps the call out of the package daily and total counters. Always consume keeps counting even when the interface-level policy says not to.
groupHelp: Do not count keeps the call out of the minute/hour/day/month free windows. Always count keeps counting even if the user group switched its quota off. The 24-hour new-account cap and the interface-wide platform caps always apply and cannot be switched off.
roleHelp: Inherit on any dimension keeps the interface-level value above; change only the dimensions that need an exception.
roleEmpty: No user groups are available yet; they appear here automatically once created.
guardRequired: This combination leaves the API completely unmetered. Enable the interface quota switch and set at least one platform-wide cap first, otherwise there is no rate limit fallback and the API can be called without bound.
meteringLoadFailed: Metering policy failed to load. Billing rules can still be saved, but the policy will not be submitted so existing settings are not reset to defaults.
meteringNotSaved: Metering policy could not be loaded, so it was skipped; billing rules were saved.
